subtopic: Conflicts of Interest and Standards of Conduct
answer: When considering an investment professional, read the firm’s relationship summary (Form CRS). It describes potential conflicts of interest and the standard of conduct associated with the firm’s services, along with the services offered and their fees and costs. Use this information to understand what to ask and to compare firms; the summary helps you identify topics to discuss, but it does not replace asking questions about the professional’s services and compensation.
